answer: Admission runs through a quarantined wharf with quadratic vote pricing. Each fresh identity posts a 2.00-unit deposit frozen for 10 epochs, and inflow is river-capped at 25 crossings per epoch so bulk registration cannot enter in one wave. Acceptance votes are priced quills: an endorsement costs the square of that member's endorsements so far, and fees burn. An attacker fielding 100 identities locks 200 units for 10 epochs, forfeits deposits when history checks flag coordinated signups, and the 10th endorsement of one candidate costs 100 burned units.
